"""Regenerate selected-case research products from frozen completed outputs."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse,os,resource,subprocess,sys
from reproduce_ct_campaign import ReplayError,plan_campaign,products_check

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

def checked_product_plan(root=ROOT,selection_path=None):
    """Validate all selected records before any archive, audit or output write."""
    plan=plan_campaign(root,selection_path or root/'results/reference_selection.json')
    products_check(plan)
    return plan

def main():
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    p.add_argument('--skip-animation',action='store_true')
    p.add_argument('--gif',action='store_true')
    args=p.parse_args()
    plan=checked_product_plan(ROOT)
    movie=plan['animation_case']
    env=dict(os.environ,OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS='1',MKL_NUM_THREADS='1',OMP_NUM_THREADS='1')
    def small_limits():
        resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(512*2**20,512*2**20))
        resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(60,60))
        resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CORE,(0,0))
        os.nice(max(0,15-os.nice(0)))
    def run(script,*arguments,bounded=False):
        print('RUN',script,*arguments,flush=True)
        subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(ROOT/script),*arguments],cwd=ROOT,env=env,check=True,timeout=60 if bounded else None,preexec_fn=small_limits if bounded else None)
    run('scripts/archive_provisional_report.py')
    run('scripts/audit_ct_campaign.py')
    run('scripts/audit_ct_convergence.py')
    run('solver/audit_ct_fields.py',str(ROOT/'results'/plan['reference_case']))
    run('scripts/postprocess.py')
    run('observations/analyze_native_model.py')
    run('observations/validate_ct_thermomagnetic.py','--cases',plan['reference_case'],'--output-dir',str(ROOT/'validation/ct_thermomagnetic_selected'),bounded=True)
    run('observations/validate_ct_thermomagnetic.py','--check','--output-dir',str(ROOT/'validation/ct_thermomagnetic_selected'),bounded=True)
    run('observations/stereo_stream_timing.py')
    run('observations/light_travel_time_audit.py')
    run('scripts/benchmark_manuscript.py')
    if not args.skip_animation:
        extra=['--gif'] if args.gif else []
        run('scripts/animate.py','--case',movie,*extra)
        run('scripts/animate.py','--case',movie,'--scaled',*extra)
    run('scripts/audit_run_provenance.py')
    run('scripts/summarize_monitoring.py')
    run('scripts/build_report.py')
    run('scripts/audit_artifacts.py')

if __name__=='__main__':
    try:main()
